violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Observed bare wood on vent hood. Observed duct tape on chest freezer lid. Observed duct tape on walk in cooler door.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Observed front and sides of griddle and stove top need to be cleaned.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Observed single use products on floor rather than on shelves.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. -Observed water leaking in walk in cooler.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -Observed cloth lying in hand sink. Hand sink is for washing hands only.
